summary.text: Old Age personified, a fatherless child of Nyx in Hesiod's genealogy of mortal afflictions.
Hyginus makes Old Age a child of Night and Erebus together.

story.text: Night bore hateful Geras without a father, placing the wasting of age beside Deceit, Friendship and Strife among the powers that accompany mortal existence.
Hyginus' genealogy calls him Senectus and gives him Erebus as father as well as Nox as mother.
